title: Remap a shortcut - Unable to type in target app field
author: Delorean5

status.label: Need the exact field and mapping
status.detail: The report says typing and Ctrl+V fail in a field while right-click paste works, but does not identify the field, target app, or configured shortcut.

next_action: Request the field/app, exact source-to-target mapping, and a current-build retest before proposing a code change.

judgment.rationale: The report gives an observable difference between keyboard input and context-menu paste, but the title and body do not identify which field, application, or remap is involved. Without those details the failure could be a Keyboard Manager mapping issue or an application field that treats keyboard and clipboard input differently.
evidence: The report lists PowerToys 0.95.0 and Keyboard Manager; reproduction is only described as clicking a field and typing.
The expected result is letters and the reported result is nothing; the additional information says Ctrl+V fails while right-click paste works.
The issue has no comments or assignees and does not state the target application, field type, or source/target mapping.
judgment.recommended_action: Ask for the exact target application and field, the saved source-to-target shortcut, and a retest on a current PowerToys build with Keyboard Manager enabled and disabled.

fix_assessment.rationale: No code change is supportable until the target field, configured mapping, and current-build behavior are identified. This is an evidence gate, not a conclusion that Keyboard Manager cannot be responsible.

issue_context.summary: The reporter cannot type or use Ctrl+V in an unspecified target-app field while Keyboard Manager is enabled; right-click paste still works.
known_information: The issue is open and labeled Issue-Bug for Keyboard Manager.
The report lists PowerToys 0.95.0 from auto-update.
The body says typing in a clicked field produces nothing and Ctrl+V does not work, while right-click paste works.
No target application, field type, or configured remap is identified; the issue has no comments.
inferences: The difference between keyboard input and context-menu paste may be specific to the target control or to a remapped shortcut, but the report does not distinguish those cases.
The failure could be caused by an unexpected mapping or by the field's own input handling; neither is confirmed.
issue_context.analysis: The issue is actionable for a precise information request, but not for a code-level design. Naming the control and mapping, then comparing behavior with Keyboard Manager disabled, will determine whether the failure follows the remap or the target app.
initial_investigation: Read the full live issue body and confirmed it has no comments or assignees.
Recorded the stated Ctrl+V versus right-click-paste difference and the missing target field/mapping details.
No linked fix or direct duplicate was identified in the issue thread.

information_gaps.information: The target app and exact field/control, plus the Keyboard Manager source-to-target mapping involved.
information_gaps.why_needed: Without the field and mapping, the reported keyboard-versus-context-menu difference cannot be attributed to Keyboard Manager or the target control.
information_gaps.how_to_collect: Name the app and field, list the configured source and target shortcut, and say whether ordinary typing and Ctrl+V work when Keyboard Manager is disabled.

information_gaps.information: Whether the same behavior reproduces on PowerToys 0.100.2 or newer.
information_gaps.why_needed: The report is from 0.95.0 and there is no later result to establish current impact.
information_gaps.how_to_collect: Retest the same mapping and field on 0.100.2 or newer and describe the result.

actions.label: Identify the field and shortcut mapping

comment.body:
Thanks for the report. It says typing and Ctrl+V fail in a field while right-click paste works, but the target app/control and saved shortcut mapping are not identified. Could you please provide:
1. The exact target app and field/control, plus the Keyboard Manager source-to-target mapping.
2. Whether the same issue reproduces on PowerToys 0.100.2 or newer.
3. Whether ordinary typing and Ctrl+V work in that field with Keyboard Manager disabled.
These details will distinguish a remap failure from input behavior specific to the target control.
